patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — HubSpot documents a broader use-case set; Keap is narrower/specialist.

Frame: General-purpose vs specialist — HubSpot documents a broader use-case set; Keap is narrower/specialist.. Choose HubSpot only if your buying job matches “AI-powered customer platform with free forever CRM, plus paid Smart CRM seats and Sales/Ma” rather than Keap's shape. Choose Keap only if use-case priority is lead-management and HubSpot is secondary for that motion. Workflow advantage: HubSpot leans pipeline-management, contact-management; Keap leans email-outreach. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — HubSpot documents a broader use-case set; Keap is narrower/specialist.
- Workflow coverage skew: HubSpot-leaning pipeline-management, contact-management, account-management vs Keap-leaning email-outreach.
- Researched limits: HubSpot — Smart CRM / Customer Platform seats and Sales Hub seats are separate ladders with different list prices; buying 'HubSpot' often means mixing Free CRM, Smart CRM seats, and hub seats.; Keap — Base plans start at $249/mo annually for two users; additional users are $39/mo each..

Limitations — HubSpot: Smart CRM / Customer Platform seats and Sales Hub seats are separate ladders with different list prices; buying 'HubSpot' often means mixing Free CRM, Smart CRM seats, and hub seats.; Sales Hub Professional starts at $100/month per seat on the Product & Services Catalog and the Sales product page (re-checked 2026-08-18). HubSpot’s Sales pricing page also shows $90/mo/seat billed annually vs $100 monthly, plus required Professional onboarding ($1,500). Starter marketing prices show new-customer discounts (*).; Keap: Base plans start at $249/mo annually for two users; additional users are $39/mo each.; Contact capacity and voice/SMS allotments scale by Max tier; overages apply for texts/voice minutes..

Poor-fit cases: HubSpot is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Smart CRM / Customer Platform seats and Sales Hub seats are separate ladders with different list prices; buying 'HubSpot' often means mixing Free CRM, Smart CRM seats, and hub seats. · Keap is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Base plans start at $249/mo annually for two users; additional users are $39/mo each.

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
